mapper.select: SELECT comment_check.user_comment_id as cid, comment_check.user_id as uid, comment_check.relic_id as rid, user.user_name as username, COALESCE(cultural_relics_data.object_name, comment_check.relic_name, CONCAT('文物#', comment_check.relic_id)) as relicname, comment_check.content as content, comment_check.created_time as created_time FROM comment_check INNER JOIN user ON comment_check.user_id = user.user_id LEFT JOIN cultural_relics_data ON comment_check.relic_id = cultural_relics_data.id WHERE comment_check.user_id=#{uid} AND comment_check.relic_id=#{rid}
